parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Good evening and thank you for coming to the Kenvale School Fair Volunteers Meeting. As you know, this is the biggest fundraising event in the school year, and as usual, we're expecting lots of people to come, which is why we're starting to prepare now, six months before the big day. I'll begin tonight by talking about the different volunteer roles, so you can decide what you'd like to do.

The entertainment coordinator position involves deciding what kinds of rides and activities will be at the fair, and making sure there's a good variety of things to do. From past experience, this role involves a lot of liaising with other helpers and the entertainers, which means that most of the work is done outside office hours.

We need an advertising and promotion coordinator to make sure that people hear about the fair and lots of people come. We know this is a big job, so we've decided to have a couple of people doing it to share the load. The parent who did this role last year has just been offered a job interstate, which starts next month, so she won't be able to lend us the benefit of her experience, sadly.

The technical coordinator makes sure that there is a suitable stage for the performers, and that there are enough speakers and people can hear them and so on. Now, this may sound like a technical background is required, but it's not, as you don't actually have to set up or fix anything yourself. Having a car is essential, though, because in the week leading up to the event, you'll need to be able to get to the school early in the mornings, and occasionally late at night.

We also need a staffing coordinator. This person will be required to look after the many helpers on the day of the fair. This role has just been created based on our experience of last year's event. We found that our volunteers felt a bit overworked, and so we're hoping that this role will make things easier. It will help to reduce stress for everyone if you organise the helpers about a month before the fair.

Now, moving on to the map of the school fair, I’ll point out some of the more important areas that you’ll need to know about so you can help direct the visitors. You can see that we’ll be using the large grounds just behind the school, and we’ll set up temporary areas and pathways there.

The first thing I’ll show you are the fairground rides, which are always popular with the children. If you look at the map, you’ll see the fair entrance at the bottom. From there, follow the main path in the direction of the river, and it’s the third area on the left, the large rectangular area.

The entertainment stage is a big feature of the fair, and this is where everyone will be able to see all the performers. To find this, go straight along the main path until you get to the river. Turn right and follow the path to the end and there it is. There’s not much shade here, so we should remind parents to bring hats for their children.

If anyone wants a cold drink or a snack, then they’ll ask you where the cafe is. Originally, we were going to put it opposite the toilets, but we’ve decided to put it near the river to take advantage of the views and breezes. You can see it on the map. It’s the circular area, surrounded by trees.

The First Aid tent is always an important part of the fair. We wanted to put that in an area that was easily accessible, and a bit separated from the other attractions, but near the entrance. If you look at the map, you’ll see it’s south of the toilets, not far from the school.

The market stalls are where visitors will be able to pick up a bargain, or some homemade produce. Last year, these were located just south of the meeting area, but the stallholders complained that it was too exposed and hot. So, this year, we’ve moved them to the north of the meeting area. Lots of good shelter provided by the trees here.

Of course, there’ll be the ever-popular pony rides. To reach these, direct visitors to follow the main path from the entrance until they reach the L-shaped area on the right, next to the playground.

analyses.content: 原文提到娱乐协调员的大部分工作是在**办公时间之外（outside office hours）**完成的，这通常指晚上。
Speaker: ...which means that most of the work is done outside office hours. (注: 引用的是包含此信息的原文语境)
听到 "outside office hours" 直接对应选项 E 的 evening work。
Speaker: We know this is a big job, so we've decided to have a couple of people doing it to share the load.
"A couple of people" 对应选项 B "More than one person"。原文提到 "starts next month" 是指上一任家长的新工作，不是指这个志愿角色的开始时间（干扰项 D）。
因为工作量大，所以决定让**几个人（a couple of people）**来分担广告宣传的工作。
Speaker: Having a car is essential, though, because in the week leading up to the event, you'll need to be able to get to the school early...
"Having a car" 直接对应选项 F "need your own transport"。原文说 "technical background... is not [required]" 排除了对专业技能的要求。
技术协调员必须有一辆车（Having a car is essential），以便在活动周早晚往返学校。
Speaker: This role has just been created based on our experience of last year's event.
"Just been created" 对应选项 C "new role"。
人员协调员这个角色是基于去年的经验而刚刚设立的（just been created）。

analyses.content: Speaker: ...follow the main path in the direction of the river, and it’s the third area on the left, the large rectangular area.
地图左侧（Main path左边）从下往上依次是：H -> Toilets -> I。
从入口出发沿主路向河流方向走，左手边的第三个区域，即那个大的长方形区域（large rectangular area）。
沿主路直走到河边，右转并走到路的尽头（end），那里就是舞台。
Speaker: Turn right and follow the path to the end and there it is.
走到最上方河边，向右拐到底，就是 D。
Speaker: It’s the circular area, surrounded by trees.
地图左上角唯一的圆形建筑 A，且周围有树。原文排除了 "opposite the toilets"（原本的计划）。
决定放在河边利用景色，是那个被树木环绕的圆形区域（circular area）。
Speaker: If you look at the map, you’ll see it’s south of the toilets, not far from the school.
找到主路左侧的 Toilets，它的南边（下方）就是 H。
位于厕所的南边（south of the toilets），离学校主楼不远。
Speaker: So, this year, we’ve moved them to the north of the meeting area. Lots of good shelter provided by the trees here.
找到右下角的 Meeting area（椭圆形），它的北边（上方）有树木的长方形区域是 E。
今年搬到了会议区（meeting area）的北边（north），因为那里有树木遮挡。
Speaker: ...until they reach the L-shaped area on the right, next to the playground.
主路右侧有两个 L 形建筑（B 和 C）。原文说 "next to the playground"（操场在路左侧），B 是路右侧正对着操场、距离最近的那个 L 形建筑。
沿主路走，直到到达右边的 L形区域（L-shaped area），它在操场（playground）的旁边/对应位置。
